b: We’re moving into the time of year for family gatherings, which means it’s the time of year for really weird career advice from family members — the uncle who’s confident the most important thing you need to get a promotion is a firm handshake, the dad who cautions you that “no one wants to work with an aggressive woman,” and the grandmother who keeps asking, “Have you thought about just applying at Google?” Then there’s the cousin who still doesn’t know what you do and the relative who won’t stop asking why your job search is taking so long. Holiday cheer abounds!
In the comments, let’s discuss the weirdest or most aggravating job-related comments you’ve gotten from a family member.
